title: Grilled Saudi-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides for a flavorful and aromatic meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together zesty tahini, smoky paprika, garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb shoulder to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or flatbread.
